subsystems.name: Ground-based radar
subsystems.role: tracks objects in low Earth orbit day or night, measuring range and velocity.

subsystems.name: Optical telescopes
subsystems.role: tracks objects in higher orbits by reflected sunlight, needing dark skies.

subsystems.name: Space-based sensors
subsystems.role: observes objects from orbit, free of weather and daylight limits.

subsystems.name: Data fusion and catalogue
subsystems.role: combines observations from many sensors into one catalogue of orbits.

subsystems.name: Conjunction assessment
subsystems.role: predicts close approaches and issues collision-avoidance warnings.

subsystems.name: Attribution and manoeuvre detection
subsystems.role: detects unannounced manoeuvres by comparing predicted and observed positions.

buildSteps.title: Define coverage requirements
buildSteps.detail: Decide which orbits and object sizes must be tracked, and how quickly warnings must be issued.

buildSteps.title: Select and build sensor sites
buildSteps.detail: Radar sites need clear horizons and power; optical sites need dark, dry, high-altitude locations with good latitude coverage.

buildSteps.title: Install and calibrate sensors
buildSteps.detail: Radars and telescopes are installed and calibrated against known objects or calibration satellites to ensure accurate pointing and timing.

buildSteps.title: Build the data pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Observations are transmitted to a central processing facility, where they are cleaned, time-stamped and correlated with existing tracks.

buildSteps.title: Maintain the catalogue
buildSteps.detail: Initial orbits are determined for new objects, and orbits are regularly updated as new observations arrive.

buildSteps.title: Develop analysis software
buildSteps.detail: Software screens for conjunctions, calculates collision probabilities, and flags manoeuvres that differ from predicted paths.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the network
buildSteps.detail: Sensors, processing and user interfaces are linked so that data flows automatically from observation to warning.

buildSteps.title: Deliver services
buildSteps.detail: Conjunction warnings, catalogue data and attribution reports are provided to satellite operators and government agencies.

buildSteps.title: Expand and improve
buildSteps.detail: New sensors, better algorithms and additional data-sharing agreements are added over time to improve coverage and accuracy.

pathway.milestone: ground-based radar and optical networks operated by governments and commercial firms
pathway.unlocks: conjunction warnings and basic attribution for satellite operators.

pathway.milestone: expansion of commercial sensor networks and dedicated space-based sensors
pathway.unlocks: more frequent tracking of smaller objects and better coverage of higher orbits.

pathway.milestone: automated collision avoidance integrated with satellite operations
pathway.unlocks: routine, low-latency manoeuvres to avoid debris without human delay.

pathway.milestone: orbital traffic management and active debris removal
pathway.unlocks: a sustainable orbital environment for large constellations and future space activities.
